title: Deliberate failure path for the live demo
context: This is the 'one failure handled gracefully' requirement from the track brief. Must be demo-able live and deterministic.
objective: Add a second mode to the buyer-agent simulator that deliberately requests something over-bound (e.g. discount above max), and confirm the API rejects it gracefully with the T5.2 guardrail engine.
scope_in: buyer_agent_sim.py --scenario=violation flag or similar, triggering an over-bound request
Confirm the response is a clean structured rejection (from T5.2), not a crash or unhandled exception
Confirm the AuditEntry for the rejection is visible and readable
acceptance_criteria: Running the violation scenario produces a clean, readable rejection message, no stack trace or 500 error
The corresponding AuditEntry in Firestore has a clear, specific reason string
This scenario is rehearsed and reliable enough to run live during the pitch video without retries
